hero_subhead: Cracked walls, uneven surfaces, or damp patches in Leeds? We restore them properly, on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Plastering & Painting Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From interior skimming and rendering to exterior repairs and full redecoration — we handle every wall challenge.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth plaster finishes on walls and ceilings, from small patches to full room renovations. Creates a perfect surface ready for paint or wallpaper.

services.title: Exterior Rendering & Repair
services.desc: Weather-resistant renders, crack repairs, and stone/brick restoration. Protects your home while improving curb appeal.

services.title: Damp & Water Damage Repair
services.desc: Identifies the source and replasters affected areas with breathable finishes. Prevents recurring problems and mould growth.

services.title: Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Interior and exterior painting using premium finishes. We prepare surfaces properly so paint lasts years, not months.

services.title: Coving & Cornice Installation
services.desc: Fitted ceiling coving and decorative cornicing adds period charm or modern clean lines. Expertly installed and finished.

services.title: Textured Finishes & Artex Removal
services.desc: Create feature walls with textured plaster, or remove and replace old Artex safely. Any finish you want, done right.

about_pullquote: I built this business fixing the botched jobs other tradesmen left behind.
about_para_1: Premier Plastering has served Leeds homeowners and businesses for over 18 years. Starting from a single van, we've grown to handle everything from small patch repairs to full house renovations — all without losing the hands-on attention to detail that sets us apart. Every job gets the same care, whether it's a £200 ceiling skim or a £5,000 exterior render.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, finishing when we say we will, and leaving your home cleaner than we found it. We don't cut corners with cheap materials or rush jobs. Customers come back because they know what to expect: honest pricing, skilled work, and plasterers who actually care about the finished result.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a huge crack running down my dining room wall — was worried it'd be expensive. Called Premier Plastering on the recommendation of a mate. They came out same week, quoted fair, and the work was immaculate. Absolutely brilliant. Will use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We needed our kitchen and bathroom completely replastered after a leak. They sorted it quickly, the finish is perfect, and they cleaned up thoroughly. Professional from start to finish. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah P.

reviews.text: Been using Premier Plastering for our rental properties for five years now. Never a problem. They're reliable, honest with pricing, and the work stands up. You don't get bad feedback about tradesmen you use repeatedly for a reason.
reviews.author: David C.
